definition_en: A clearance state in which the police have identified a probable offender of the recorded act.
A clearance state in which no offender of the recorded act has been identified.
A clearance state in which the police concluded that the recorded act did not take place.
business_definition_cs: Policie dospěla k závěru, že se oznámený skutek nestal.

definition_en: A clearance state in which the police concluded that the recorded act took place but is not a crime.
business_definition_cs: Policie dospěla k závěru, že se skutek stal, ale není trestným činem.

definition_en: A location relevance indicating that no meaning was assigned to the recorded location.
business_definition_cs: Zveřejněnému místu nebyl přiřazen žádný význam.

definition_en: A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is where the act was reported.
business_definition_cs: Zveřejněné místo je místem, kde byl skutek oznámen.

definition_en: A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is where the consequence of the act occurred.
business_definition_cs: Zveřejněné místo je místem, kde nastal následek skutku.

definition_en: A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is where the act was committed.
business_definition_cs: Zveřejněné místo je místem, kde byl skutek spáchán.

definition_en: A location relevance indicating that the act relates to a place outside the Czech Republic.
business_definition_cs: Skutek se týká místa mimo Českou republiku.

definition_en: A location relevance indicating that the recorded location is known to be wrong.
business_definition_cs: Zveřejněné místo je známo jako chybné.
